query: ESG指标与薪酬挂钩 ESG指标与薪酬挂钩 衡量ESG绩效在高管薪酬中的绑定程度。 0分 无机制/未披露 违反港交所强制披露规定。具体指：未在年报“董事会报告”或“企业管治报告”中明确回应薪酬与ESG的关联审查。 1分 定性绑定 / 模糊权重 仅限于披露了“ESG指标作为薪酬考量因素之一”，但仅局限于定性调整项（Modifier） 或仅挂钩非实质性指标（如：按时发布ESG报告、获得ESG奖项）。 2分 量化权重 满足以下两个条件中的一个即可： 1. 量化目标：必须披露具体的KPI数值（如：范围1+2碳排放下降X%）。 2. 权重透明：明确写明年终花红（Bonus）中ESG权重≥X%。 ESG薪酬挂钩 可持续发展激励 花红权重 ESG考核指标 短期激励 长期激励 薪酬委员会 定性调节项 STIP LTIP KPI ESG-linked remuneration sustainability-linked incentives bonus weight ESG KPI STIP LTIP pay for performance remuneration committee modifier KPI 高管薪酬是否与ESG绩效挂钩？ 是否披露具体量化KPI（如排放下降X%）？ 年终花红中ESG权重是否明确？ 若仅为定性modifier或非实质性指标，具体是什么？ 薪酬委员会如何审议该安排？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator 'ESG指标与薪酬挂钩'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 高管薪酬是否与ESG绩效挂钩？ 是否披露具体量化KPI（如排放下降X%）？ 年终花红中ESG权重是否明确？ 若仅为定性modifier或非实质性指标，具体是什么？ 薪酬委员会如何审议该安排？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有董事会ESG监督、企业减排目标或员工股权激励，但未明确进入高管薪酬；仅有一般薪酬委员会职责而无ESG关联。不要排除按时发布ESG报告、获得ESG奖项等非实质性KPI：若明确挂钩高管薪酬，应作为1分弱绑定证据。区分：定性modifier或非实质性KPI支持1分；具体ESG KPI数值或明确奖金权重支持2分。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

GOVERNANCE & OPERATIONAL RESPONSIBILITY / ESG GOVERNANCE STRUCTURE

[Content]
In 2020, the Group formally established the Sustainability Committee to carry out planning, risk identification and assessment on ESG matters. The committee, which includes 2 independent non-executive directors and 3 executive directors, regularly convenes committee meetings with the management and external consultants of the Group to ensure that the management and all employees are involved in and engaged in the Group's sustainability management. We carry out the Group's comprehensive sustainability management with a sustainable development hierarchy to ensure that the management and frontline employees identify the Group's ESG responsibilities, and voluntarily participate in ESG management, so as to jointly realize the Group's sustainable development vision.

results.text: We uphold green and low carbon emission as the principle of our operations. We have recorded improvement in various key performance indices of environmental protection in 2021, including a year-on-year decrease of 2.2% in total energy consumption per unit revenue and a year-on-year decrease of 1.9% in greenhouse gas emission per unit revenue. We have established and implemented annual environmental goals and management plans during the year to ensure continuous improvement of the environmental management system. The Group plans to set up long-term realizable targets of greenhouse gas emissions and energy consumption intensity in 2022. Determination and efforts of the Group in energy conservation have been recognized by professional institutions. The Group won the grand award of 'Excellent ESG Enterprise of 2020-2021' by Hong Kong Economic Times in 2021 and was granted green loan of a total of approximately HK$400 million by DBS Bank and Citibank for purchase of environmentally friendly and energy-efficient production equipment.

MESSAGE FROM OUR CHAIRMAN

[Content]
We uphold green and low carbon emission as the principle of our operations. We have recorded improvement in various key performance indices of environmental protection in 2021, including a year-on-year decrease of 2.2% in total energy consumption per unit revenue and a year-on-year decrease of 1.9% in greenhouse gas emission per unit revenue. We have established and implemented annual environmental goals and management plans during the year to ensure continuous improvement of the environmental management system. The Group plans to set up long-term realizable targets of greenhouse gas emissions and energy consumption intensity in 2022. Determination and efforts of the Group in energy conservation have been recognized by professional institutions. The Group won the grand award of 'Excellent ESG Enterprise of 2020-2021' by Hong Kong Economic Times in 2021 and was granted green loan of a total of approximately HK$400 million by DBS Bank and Citibank for purchase of environmentally friendly and energy-efficient production equipment.
